subject.why: Clearly depicts a wide-brimmed straw hat with a red band.

category.why: Matches category 2 with a plain ground and smooth gradient wall.

clean.why: Free of UI, text, watermarks, and characters.

framing.why: The wide brim crowds the left and right margins too closely.

colour.why: Vibrant palette with clear contrast against the planned blue background.

detail.why: The surface is broken into a busy lattice of repetitive segments.

style.why: The straw reads as molded plastic tubing rather than stylized natural fiber.

bg_colour.why: background is blue (97% of the background); planned blue

fix: Scale the hat down slightly, simplify the weave into broader smooth bands, and soften the plastic look.
